cases.name: Reuse a real batch
cases.prompt: Plan Monday and Tuesday dinner for two. One pot of lentil stew makes four portions from 2 cups of lentils.
expectations: Schedules the first cook before the leftover meal.
Lists 2 cups of lentils in the grocery handoff.

cases.name: Recurring night without a calendar
cases.prompt: We do tacos on Tuesdays. Make a reusable two-night menu for Tuesday and Wednesday, with no calendar access.
expectations: Provides a second menu slot for Wednesday.
Labels Tuesday's recurrence in the reusable menu.
Returns a copyable schedule without claiming calendar updates.

cases.name: Conflicting favorite
cases.prompt: Our favorite peanut noodles take 45 minutes. A guest has a peanut allergy and we have 20 minutes. Suggest a plan.
expectations: Filters the favorite out of the guest's shared meal.
Flags unverified ingredients before declaring a dish suitable.
Offers a feasible replacement or asks for a usable recipe.
